video: 60-second vertical explainer that shows how an AI agent gets a task done: it plans steps, uses tools, checks results and retries when a step fails

bubble_enter.what: The request chat bubble fades in, rises slightly and settles

request_typing.what: The request text types into the bubble letter by letter at a steady pace

send_arrow_draw.what: A send arrow draws itself beside the request text

checkboxes_rise.what: Three empty checkboxes fade in and rise into place one after another under the bubble

camera_move.what: The camera pans and zooms smoothly to the next part of the task board

reply_enter.what: The chatbot's reply bubble fades in and grows slightly under the request

reply_lines_write.what: Lines of text fill the reply bubble one after another at a steady pace

checkboxes_pushed_down.what: The three empty checkboxes slide down to make room for the reply bubble

not_booked_bracket.what: A bracket draws itself under the empty checkboxes and its label fades in and rises

not_booked_exit.what: The bracket and its label fade away

reply_folds_into_agent.what: The reply bubble shrinks and reshapes into a small dark pill

agent_label_enter.what: The word Agent fades in on the pill and a soft glow appears behind it

arms_draw.what: Three lines draw outward from the agent pill toward three action buttons

arms_retract.what: The three lines pull back into the agent pill and disappear

action_buttons_enter.what: Three round action buttons fade in and grow slightly at the ends of the lines

tool_icons_draw.what: The magnifier, calendar and bed icons draw themselves line by line inside the buttons

bubble_to_header.what: The request bubble slides up and reshapes into the header of the checklist card

card_outline_draw.what: The outline of the tall checklist card draws itself below the header

checkboxes_to_rows.what: The three checkboxes slide from under the bubble into the checklist as the first three rows

fourth_checkbox_enter.what: A fourth checkbox fades in and rises into the last row

row_labels_write.what: Each step name writes itself from left to right at a steady pace

agent_settles_in_lane.what: The agent pill slides to the left edge of the first row and shrinks to fit

buttons_to_tool_cards.what: The three round buttons slide to the right side and grow into three stacked tool cards

tool_label_enter.what: Each tool card's name fades in and rises while a soft color fills in behind its icon

row_outline_draw.what: An outline draws itself around the checklist row the agent is working on

row_outline_off.what: The outline around a finished row fades away

connector_draw.what: A line draws itself from the active row to its tool card

connector_retract.what: The line between a row and its tool card pulls back and disappears

tool_outline_active.what: A tool card's outline changes color from navy to violet while the tool is in use

request_travel.what: A dot and a small request chip glide from the row along the line into the tool card

magnifier_sweep.what: The magnifier icon on the search card tilts left and right once as it searches

result_chip_return.what: A result chip glides from the tool card back to the row and docks under the step name

check_bracket_draw.what: A bracket draws itself linking the result chip to the step name as the agent checks it

tick_draw.what: A tick draws itself in the row's checkbox

agent_travel.what: The agent pill slides down the checklist to the next row

calendar_day_fill.what: The Saturday cell on the calendar icon fills with color

booking_card_dims.what: The booking card's fill changes to flat gray when the booking fails

cross_draw.what: A cross draws itself over the bed icon on the booking card

sold_out_exit.what: The sold out chip drops slightly and fades away

retry_arrow_draw.what: A circular arrow draws itself once around the agent pill and the words try again fade in beside it

retry_arrow_exit.what: The circular arrow and its label fade away

booking_card_recovers.what: The booking card's fill changes back from gray to white and the cross fades

summary_chip_enter.what: A trip summary chip fades in and rises under the last step

loop_arrow_draw.what: A large loop arrow draws itself around the whole board

loop_stations_enter.what: Three labeled stations, plan, act and check, fade in and rise onto the loop one after another

loop_dot_run.what: A dot runs once around the loop at a constant speed

loop_station_light.what: Each station changes color to violet as the dot passes it

loop_exit.what: The loop arrow and its stations fade away

board_dims.what: The task board fades back to a pale version so the trip card stands out

summary_to_trip_card.what: The trip summary chip glides to the center and grows into a large trip card

trip_lines_enter.what: The flight, hotel and dates lines fade in and rise on the trip card one after another

approve_button_enter.what: The approve payment button fades in and rises below the trip card

cursor_enter.what: A hand cursor fades in and glides onto the approve button

button_press.what: The approve button dips slightly and springs back as the cursor presses it

button_fill.what: The approve button's fill changes from white to violet after the press

headline_reveal.what: Each headline line slides up into view from behind an invisible edge

headline_exit.what: The headline fades out at the end of its scene

subtitle_words.what: Subtitle words brighten in groups of three as the narrator says them

world_fade_out.what: The whole task board fades away before the logo appears

checkboxes_to_logo_bars.what: The four ticked checkboxes slide together into a row and become the feet of the logo bars

logo_bars_grow.what: Four logo bars grow upward from a baseline one after another, left to right

logo_wordmark_reveal.what: The brand name is revealed left to right by a moving edge

logo_glow.what: The logo bars glow brighter, then settle to a soft glow

tagline_enter.what: The tagline fades in and rises into place under the logo

cta_enter.what: The call-to-action button fades in and rises into place

cta_arrow_nudge.what: The arrow on the button slides a little to the right once

camera_breathing.what: The whole picture slowly and very slightly zooms in and out in a continuous loop, so held frames do not look frozen
